mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer and business demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
